## Step 2: Data Cleaning & Filtering
```{r}

clean_data <- data %>%
  # Keep only Baseline (BL) data
  filter(EVENT_ID == "BL") %>%
  
  # 1 = PD, 2 = Healthy Control, 4 = Prodromal
  filter(COHORT %in% c(1, 2, 4)) %>%
  
  # Create Labels
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      COHORT == 1 ~ "PD",
      COHORT == 2 ~ "Healthy Control",
      COHORT == 4 ~ "Prodromal"
    ),
    # Set factor levels order: Healthy -> Prodromal -> PD
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Healthy Control", "Prodromal", "PD"))
  ) %>%
  
  # Select Variables
  select(
    PATNO,           # Patient ID
    Group,           # Cohort Group
    age,             # Age
    SEX,             # Sex
    
    #  Early Risk Factors (Non-Motor) 
    upsit,           # Smell (Lower = Worse)
    rem,             # Sleep / RBD (Higher = Worse)
    scopa,           # Autonomic (Higher = Worse)
    
    #  Clinical Symptoms 
    updrs3_score,    # Motor Symptoms (Higher = Worse)
    moca,            # Cognition (Lower = Worse)
    
    # Biomarkers & Genetics
    subgroup,        # Genetic Subgroups
    MIA_PUTAMEN_L    # Brain Dopamine (DaTscan Left Putamen)
  )

# 3. Check Data
summary(clean_data %>% select(age, upsit, rem, updrs3_score, moca))
```
### Data Collection Flow Chart
```{r}

n_raw <- nrow(data) # Original number of rows
n_baseline <- data %>% filter(EVENT_ID == "BL") %>% nrow()
n_final <- clean_data %>% nrow()

box_data <- tibble(
  x = c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
  y = c(0.9, 0.5, 0.1),
  label = c(
    paste0("Raw Data\n(N = ", n_raw, ")"),
    paste0("Baseline Visits Only\n(Event_ID = 'BL')\n(N = ", n_baseline, ")"),
    paste0("Final Analytical Cohort\n(Healthy, PD, Prodromal)\n(N = ", n_final, ")")
  )
)

arrow_data <- tibble(
  x = c(0.5, 0.5),
  xend = c(0.5, 0.5),
  y = c(0.8, 0.4),
  yend = c(0.6, 0.2)
)

ggplot() +
  # Draw Boxes
  geom_rect(data = box_data, 
            aes(xmin = x - 0.2, xmax = x + 0.2, ymin = y - 0.1, ymax = y + 0.1),
            fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1) +
  # Add Text 
  geom_text(data = box_data, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), size = 4) +
  # Add Arrows
  geom_segment(data = arrow_data, 
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed"), 
               size = 1) +
  theme_void() +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  labs(title = "Figure 1: Data Selection Flow Chart")
```
### Descriptive Statistics of Study Measurements

```{r}

table_data <- clean_data %>%
  select(Group, 
         `Age` = age, 
         `Smell (UPSIT)` = upsit, 
         `Sleep (RBD)` = rem, 
         `Autonomic (SCOPA)` = scopa, 
         `Motor (UPDRS III)` = updrs3_score, 
         `Cognition (MoCA)` = moca,
         `Dopamine (DaTscan)` = MIA_PUTAMEN_L) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "Measurement", values_to = "Value")

summary_table <- table_data %>%
  group_by(Group, Measurement) %>%
  summarise(
    N = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    Mean = round(mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD = round(sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median = round(median(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min = round(min(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max = round(max(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%

  arrange(Group, Measurement)

kable(summary_table, caption = "Table 1: Descriptive Statistics of Study Measurements")
```

## Step 3: Visualization 
```{r}


plot_data <- clean_data %>%
  select(Group, upsit, rem, scopa, updrs3_score, moca) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Group,
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

metric_labels <- c(
  "upsit" = "Smell (UPSIT) - Lower is Worse",
  "rem" = "Sleep (RBD Score) - Higher is Worse",
  "scopa" = "Autonomic (SCOPA) - Higher is Worse",
  "updrs3_score" = "Motor (UPDRS III) - Higher is Worse",
  "moca" = "Cognition (MoCA) - Lower is Worse"
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Group, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  # Jitter points for detail
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.1, size = 0.05) +
  
  # Facet wrap to show 5 plots
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(metric_labels)) +
  
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Early PD Risk Factors",
    subtitle = "Comparing Healthy Control vs. Prodromal vs. PD",
    x = "", 
    y = "Score",
    fill = "Cohort"
  )
```
```{r}


# 1. Categorize Genetics
pd_genetic_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(Group == "PD") %>%  # Select only PD patients
  mutate(
    Genetic_Status = case_when(
      grepl("LRRK2", subgroup) ~ "LRRK2",
      grepl("GBA", subgroup) ~ "GBA",
      grepl("SNCA", subgroup) ~ "SNCA",
      TRUE ~ "Sporadic" # Default to Sporadic if no mutation found
    )
  )

# 2. Plot A: Genetics vs. Smell (UPSIT)
p1 <- ggplot(pd_genetic_data, aes(x = Genetic_Status, y = upsit, fill = Genetic_Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Genotype on Smell (PD Only)",
    subtitle = "Note: LRRK2 patients often have better smell (higher scores)",
    x = "Genetic Subtype",
    y = "UPSIT Score (Smell)"
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p1)

# 3. Plot B: Genetics vs. Cognition (MoCA)
p2 <- ggplot(pd_genetic_data, aes(x = Genetic_Status, y = moca, fill = Genetic_Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "magma") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of Genotype on Cognition (PD Only)",
    subtitle = "Note: GBA patients may have lower cognitive scores",
    x = "Genetic Subtype",
    y = "MoCA Score (Cognition)"
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p2)
```
```{r}


# 1. Correlation: Smell vs. Brain Dopamine
cor_smell <- cor.test(clean_data$upsit, clean_data$MIA_PUTAMEN_L, use = "complete.obs")

# Plot 1: Smell vs Dopamine
p3 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = upsit, y = MIA_PUTAMEN_L)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = TRUE) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Biological Evidence: Smell Loss vs. Brain Dopamine",
    subtitle = paste("Correlation (r) =", round(cor_smell$estimate, 3), 
                     "- Worse Smell (Left) correlates with Lower Dopamine (Bottom)"),
    x = "UPSIT Score (Smell)",
    y = "Putamen DaTscan (Dopamine Level)",
    color = "Cohort"
  )

print(p3)

# 2. Correlation: Motor Symptoms vs. Brain Dopamine
cor_motor <- cor.test(clean_data$updrs3_score, clean_data$MIA_PUTAMEN_L, use = "complete.obs")

# Plot 2: Motor vs Dopamine
p4 <- ggplot(clean_data, aes(x = MIA_PUTAMEN_L, y = updrs3_score)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Group), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  theme_light() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Biological Evidence: Dopamine Loss vs. Motor Symptoms",
    subtitle = paste("Correlation (r) =", round(cor_motor$estimate, 3), 
                     "(Negative correlation: Lower Dopamine = Higher/Worse Motor Score)"),
    x = "Putamen DaTscan (Dopamine Level)",
    y = "MDS-UPDRS III Score (Motor Symptoms)",
    color = "Cohort"
  )

print(p4)
```

```{r}

reg_data <- clean_data %>%
  drop_na(upsit, rem, scopa, MIA_PUTAMEN_L)

logit_data <- reg_data %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("PD", "Healthy Control")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create Target Variable: 1 = PD (Disease), 0 = Healthy
    is_PD = ifelse(Group == "PD", 1, 0)
  )

model_logit <- glm(is_PD ~ upsit + rem + scopa + age + SEX, 
                   data = logit_data, 
                   family = binomial)

summary(model_logit) 

exp(coef(model_logit))


model_linear <- lm(MIA_PUTAMEN_L ~ upsit + rem + scopa + age, 
                   data = reg_data)

print("--- Brain Dopamine Prediction Model ---")
summary(model_linear)


library(broom)


tidy_logit <- tidy(model_logit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Remove Intercept


ggplot(tidy_logit, aes(x = estimate, y = term, xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") + # 1 represents no effect
  labs(
    title = "PD Risk Factor Odds Ratios",
    subtitle = "Left of 1 = Protective Factor, Right of 1 = Risk Factor",
    x = "Odds Ratio",
    y = "Risk Factor"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
